films.title: Them
films.overview: Lucas and Clementine live peacefully in their isolated country house, but one night they wake up to strange noise. They're not alone... and a group of hooded assailants begin to terrorize them throughout the night.

films.title: The Eye
films.overview: Violinist Sydney Wells was accidentally blinded by her sister Helen when she was five years old. She submits to a cornea transplantation, and while recovering from the operation, she realizes that she is seeing dead people.

films.title: Blind Man
films.overview: A police inspector must solve two grisly murders. The problem is that his only suspect is a blind man.
